prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
competitors_mentioned: Shadow Work® Basic Facilitator Training Online

answer_verbatim:
If you want **shadow work** with a strong **spiritual practice** angle, the best options in the results are **Jung Platform’s _Encounters with the Shadow_**, **Sounds True’s _Facing Your Shadow_** (listed in the roundup), and **ManTalks’ _Shadow Course_**. These stand out because they explicitly connect inner work, self-awareness, and transformation rather than treating shadow work as only a generic self-help exercise.[2][1][18]

Here’s a practical shortlist:

- **Jung Platform — _Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work / Encounters with the Shadow_**: Best if you want a more psychologically grounded, Jungian approach; the course focuses on unconscious projections, patterns, and self-awareness with James Hollis.[2][6]
- **Sounds True — _Facing Your Shadow_**: Included in the “best shadow work courses” roundup and likely a strong fit if you want a well-known spiritual/self-development publisher’s approach.[1]
- **ManTalks — _Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential_**: An 8-week guided process aimed at facing and integrating the shadow, which may suit you if you want structured, ongoing practice.[18]
- **Udemy — _Shadow Work Course and Workbook_**: Good if you want a lower-cost, practice-heavy option with meditations, prayers, and exercises explicitly framed as spiritual transformation.[10]
- **Awake Academy / Charlie Morley — _Embracing The Shadow_**: Highlighted by a reviewer as highly transformative, which may appeal if you want a more experiential, spiritually oriented course.[20]
- **Zachary Phillips — _Hunt Your Own Shadow_**: A free 12-week self-paced course, useful if you want to explore the material without paying first.[16]

If your priority is **serious depth and credibility**, I’d rank them this way:

| Best for | Course |
|---|---|
| Jungian depth and theory | Jung Platform — _Encounters with the Shadow_ |
| Spiritual/self-development framing | Sounds True — _Facing Your Shadow_ |
| Guided long-form practice | ManTalks — _Shadow Course_ |
| Budget-friendly experimentation | Udemy — _Shadow Work Course and Workbook_ or the free _Hunt Your Own Shadow_ |
| Experiential transformation | Awake Academy — _Embracing The Shadow_ |

A few notes before choosing:
- Some courses are more **psychological** than explicitly **spiritual**, even if they use transformation language.[2][11]
- Udemy options vary in quality because they are more marketplace-style courses, so reviews and instructor background matter more there than with established publishers.[3][10][12]
- If you want **facilitated or practitioner-level training**, **Shadow Work® Basic Facilitator Training Online** and the **Shadow Work Practitioner Certificate** are more advanced, but they are aimed at training facilitators rather than casual learners.[7][8]

If you want, I can turn this into a **top 5 ranked list by budget, depth, and spiritual focus**.
